tools.name: build_sales_brief
tools.description: Map a prospect's non-sensitive organization profile and stated needs to ETTE's documented plan, service lines, proof points, discovery questions, pricing guidance, and next step. This is a fit aid, not a quote or acceptance decision. Do not submit names, emails, phone numbers, or confidential details.

tools.name: get_case_studies
tools.description: List published ETTE case studies for buyer proof, or retrieve the complete published text of one case study by slug.

slug.description: Optional case-study slug from the list response

tools.name: get_company_overview
tools.description: Get a concise, source-backed overview of ETTE, its target customers, delivery model, service area, and differentiators. Use this first for general buyer questions.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Get ETTE's published phone, office, business hours, advisor-booking link, and contact page. This tool does not submit a form or create a lead.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Return ETTE's published plan pricing and proposal caveats. Optionally calculate a non-binding monthly starting estimate from plan, active-user count, and listed advisory add-ons.

user_count.description: Active people who need IT support

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Get the published detail for one ETTE service. Use a slug returned by list_services; do not infer unlisted commitments from the content.

slug.description: A service slug returned by list_services

tools.name: inspect_image_c2pa
tools.description: Fetch a single image (by CSS selector or URL) and return its fully decoded C2PA manifest store: every manifest's claim, assertions (e.g. c2pa.actions edit history, schema.org authorship), and the COSE signature details (algorithm and signing-certificate identity). Provide exactly one of `selector` or `url`. Note: the signature is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

selector.description: CSS selector for an element on the page.

url.description: Image URL (absolute, or relative to the current page) to fetch and inspect.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List ETTE's published managed IT, security, cloud, and advisory service lines with stable slugs. Call get_service for the detail behind one service.

tools.name: scan_images_c2pa
tools.description: Scan every on the current page for C2PA Content Credentials (content provenance metadata) and return a per-image summary: whether a manifest is present, the claim generator (the tool that produced or edited the image), the title, and the signer name. Use this to find which images on a page carry provenance data. Note: provenance is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

limit.description: Maximum number of images to fetch and scan (default 25, max 100).

tools.name: search_ette
tools.description: Search the bundled ETTE website snapshot across services, buyer pages, FAQs, pricing, and case studies. Returns ranked excerpts, content type, and source URLs; use a specific content tool when one is available.
